title.label: Question paper name
title.help: Printed at the top of the paper. Leave blank and the planner names it from the syllabus.

language.label: Paper language
language.help: The language the questions are written in.

instructions.label: General instructions
instructions.help: One instruction per line, printed as (i), (ii)… under the marks strip. Edit freely.

diagrams.label: Generate diagrams where a question needs one
diagrams.help: Diagrams from the book are always used. Turn this on to also draw a labelled figure for questions that need one the book does not have — about a minute per figure, billed per image. Review every drawn figure before printing.

examDate.label: Exam date (optional)
examDate.help: Printed in the Date field on the paper. Leave blank to print a line for the student to fill.
